name.zh: 20 号公路（奇尔科廷—贝拉库拉公路）

aka.en: Freedom Road (Anahim Lake to the Bella Coola valley, 1953)
aka.zh: 自由之路（阿纳海姆湖至贝拉库拉河谷段，1953 年）

tagline.en: Across the Chilcotin plateau to the coast, its last link pushed through by two bulldozers and the Bella Coola valley's own Board of Trade, and still ending in the Hill
tagline.zh: 横越奇尔科廷高原直抵海岸：最后一段由两台推土机和贝拉库拉河谷自己的商会打通，终点前仍是那段“大坡”

start.en: Bella Coola, at the head of North Bentinck Arm on the central coast
start.zh: 中部海岸北本廷克湾顶端的贝拉库拉

end.en: Williams Lake, at Highway 97 in the Cariboo
end.zh: 卡里布地区的威廉斯湖，与 97 号公路相接

en: Highway 20 runs about 455 km west from Williams Lake across the Chilcotin plateau to Bella Coola, the only road into the town. Leaving Williams Lake it crosses the Fraser River on the Sheep Creek Bridge and climbs onto the plateau, running through Alexis Creek, Tatla Lake and Anahim Lake.

Past Anahim Lake it crosses the Coast Mountains at Heckman Pass, 1,524 metres, on the edge of Tweedsmuir Provincial Park, and then comes the Hill: about 43 km of descent into the Bella Coola valley, with switchbacks, grades of up to 18 per cent and no guardrails. Below it the road follows the Bella Coola River down the valley to the town.
In 2016 all but about 42 km of the highway was paved.
zh: 20 号公路自威廉斯湖向西横越奇尔科廷高原，通往贝拉库拉，全长约 455 公里，是进入该镇的唯一公路。出威廉斯湖后，公路经希普溪大桥跨过弗雷泽河，再爬上高原，途经亚历克西斯溪、塔特拉湖和阿纳海姆湖。
过了阿纳海姆湖，公路在特威兹缪尔省立公园边缘经海拔 1,524 米的赫克曼山口翻越海岸山脉，接着便是“大坡”：约 43 公里的下坡路通入贝拉库拉河谷，之字形弯道，坡度最高达 18%，且没有护栏。坡下，公路沿贝拉库拉河顺河谷而下，抵达镇上。
到 2016 年，除约 42 公里外，全线均已铺装。

en: Until 1953 the road from Williams Lake ended at Anahim Lake, and the Bella Coola valley was reached only by sea. The Bella Coola Board of Trade, led by Cliff Kopas, decided to build the missing link themselves. Work began on 14 September 1952 with $250 in hand.

Two bulldozers worked towards each other: Alf Bracewell on a D6 from the Anahim Lake end, and George Dalshaug on a TD18 from the valley, where Elijah Gurr led the work. They met on 26 September 1953, completing about 76 km from Anahim Lake to the bottom of the Hill. The road became known as the Freedom Road, and the province, which had eventually contributed most of the money, had Public Works Minister Phil Gaglardi open it officially on 18 July 1955.

At the other end, the Fraser River was crossed by a suspension bridge built in 1904 until the Sheep Creek Bridge, 912 feet long, was built in 1960–61 and officially opened in September 1962. More than $50 million was reported in 2016 to have been spent upgrading the highway over the previous eight to ten years.
zh: 直到 1953 年，从威廉斯湖出发的公路一直止于阿纳海姆湖，贝拉库拉河谷只能经海路到达。以克利夫·科帕斯为首的贝拉库拉商会决定自己动手修通这一缺口。1952 年 9 月 14 日，他们带着 250 加元开工。
两台推土机相向推进：阿尔夫·布雷斯韦尔驾驶一台 D6 从阿纳海姆湖一端推进，乔治·达尔肖格驾驶一台 TD18 从河谷一端推进，河谷一侧的工程由伊莱贾·格尔带领。1953 年 9 月 26 日两机会合，打通了从阿纳海姆湖到“大坡”坡底约 76 公里的道路。这条路被称为“自由之路”；最终承担了大部分费用的省政府，于 1955 年 7 月 18 日由公共工程部长菲尔·加利亚尔迪主持正式通车。
在另一端，弗雷泽河上原有一座 1904 年建成的悬索桥；长 912 英尺的希普溪大桥于 1960—1961 年建成，1962 年 9 月正式启用。据 2016 年报道，此前八到十年间用于改善这条公路的投入逾 5,000 万加元。

en: The Freedom Road cost about $62,000, of which about $58,000 came from the provincial government and $4,000 from the public, according to the Bella Coola Valley Museum. The Sheep Creek Bridge cost $1 million. Recent work has been paid for by the province, in contracts such as the $6.2 million one awarded to Peter Bros. in 2016.
zh: 据贝拉库拉河谷博物馆记载，“自由之路”造价约 6.2 万加元，其中约 5.8 万加元来自省政府，4,000 加元来自民间。希普溪大桥造价 100 万加元。近年的工程由省政府出资，例如 2016 年授予 Peter Bros. 公司的 620 万加元合同。

value.en: 454.94 km, Williams Lake to Bella Coola.
value.zh: 威廉斯湖至贝拉库拉 454.94 公里。

figures.source: English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 20 (citing the BC Ministry of Transportation Landmark Kilometre Inventory)

value.en: No total for the highway. The Freedom Road, Anahim Lake to the Bella Coola valley: about $62,000 (1952–53). The Sheep Creek Bridge over the Fraser: $1 million (1960–61).
value.zh: 全线无总造价。阿纳海姆湖至贝拉库拉河谷的“自由之路”：约 6.2 万加元（1952—1953 年）。弗雷泽河上的希普溪大桥：100 万加元（1960—1961 年）。

figures.source: Bella Coola Valley Museum, The Freedom Road; Williams Lake Tribune, on the history of the Sheep Creek Bridge

value.en: Province of British Columbia. The Freedom Road was started by the Bella Coola Board of Trade with $250; of its final cost about $58,000 was provincial and $4,000 public.
value.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省政府。“自由之路”由贝拉库拉商会以 250 加元起步修建；最终造价中约 5.8 万加元来自省政府，4,000 加元来自民间。

figures.source: Bella Coola Valley Museum, The Freedom Road

value.en: About 43 km of descent from Heckman Pass (1,524 m) into the Bella Coola valley, with grades of up to 18 per cent and no guardrails.
value.zh: 自赫克曼山口（海拔 1,524 米）下降至贝拉库拉河谷约 43 公里，坡度最高 18%，无护栏。

value.en: More than $50 million in the eight to ten years to 2016; all but about 42 km paved by then.
value.zh: 截至 2016 年的八到十年间逾 5,000 万加元；当时除约 42 公里外均已铺装。

figures.source: Vancouver Sun / Times Colonist, 2016; BC Government news release 2016TRAN0153

timeline.en: A suspension bridge is built over the Fraser River at Sheep Creek.
timeline.zh: 希普溪处的弗雷泽河上建成一座悬索桥。

timeline.en: The Bella Coola Board of Trade starts building the road to Anahim Lake on 14 September, with $250.
timeline.zh: 9 月 14 日，贝拉库拉商会带着 250 加元开始修建通往阿纳海姆湖的道路。

timeline.en: The two bulldozers meet on 26 September, joining Bella Coola to the Chilcotin by road.
timeline.zh: 9 月 26 日两台推土机会合，贝拉库拉首次经公路连通奇尔科廷。

timeline.en: Public Works Minister Phil Gaglardi officially opens the Freedom Road on 18 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 18 日，公共工程部长菲尔·加利亚尔迪主持“自由之路”正式通车。

timeline.en: The Sheep Creek Bridge over the Fraser, built in 1960–61, is officially opened in September.
timeline.zh: 1960—1961 年建成的弗雷泽河希普溪大桥于 9 月正式启用。

timeline.en: The province awards a $6.2 million highway contract; all but about 42 km of the highway is now paved.
timeline.zh: 省政府授出 620 万加元的公路工程合同；此时全线除约 42 公里外均已铺装。
